variants.inverted_index_ohne_tokenpruefung: measurement-internal copy without checked_tokens set and tokenize(token) contract check; AST otherwise identical to production function

parameters.share: (median_a - median_b) / median_a per dataset; a=public build, b=copy without token check

timer: time.perf_counter_ns via gemeinsam.messung.measure_phase; integer elapsed_ns per complete build
background_load: Keine parallelen Messungen, Agenten oder Builds; Videopipeline pausiert; Lastmittel vor Start 1.25 2.58 4.52
cache: same prepared corpus reused for every build; no cold-cache claim

timing_boundaries.inverted_index: complete public build_inverted_index on already prepared corpus, as build phase of series 02
timing_boundaries.inverted_index_ohne_tokenpruefung: identical except checked_tokens bookkeeping and tokenize(token) contract check
timing_boundaries.excluded: generation, loading, preparation, AST check, index equality checks, result validation, output

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3, IQR=Q3-Q1; share=(median_a-median_b)/median_a; variants measured in separate measure_phase blocks, so repeats are not paired; quartiles are not confidence intervals
interpretation_limits: Difference a-b contains tokenize calls per distinct token and the checked_tokens set bookkeeping per posting.
Copy and production code are separate functions; equal AST does not exclude small interpreter-level differences.
Only the V series of series 02 (N=100000, D=100); no statement about other corpora.
